snippet.description:
“Gravity” is the fifth standalone single from South Korean electronic artist ALEX 봉황 (Alex Kinchen), following earlier releases like “I Dare You,” “Boost,” “Black,” and “Better.” 

With Gravity, Alex reaches deeper into atmospheric textures and emotive energy, creating a sound that’s both expansive and introspective.

Production on the track was led by Nam Dong Hyun (남동현), a South Korean singer‑songwriter, producer, and musician known for his independent work under his own name after previously performing as BOYHOOD. Nam Dong Hyun first debuted as a solo artist in 2017 and has since become recognized for writing, composing, and producing his own music, blending introspective songwriting with modern indie‑pop and electronic influences. He was also a bassist in the band South Club and participated in Produce X 101, showcasing his versatility and deep connection to the creative process.

By collaborating with Nam Dong Hyun, Gravity brings together Alex’s immersive electronic and R&B vision and Nam’s rich indie‑producer sensibility.

snippet.description:
“I Dare You” is a song recorded by South Korean independent electronic artist Alex Kinchen, professionally known as ALEX 봉황. The track was released both as the opening song on the digital mini album iBBB and as his fourth standalone Korean single, following previous digital releases including “Boost,” “Black,” and “Better,” all issued through MYTHS And LEGENDS Records.

The visual art direction for “I Dare You” was created by Lee Min-Jeong, who has produced visual works for numerous artists under MUSIC&NEW. The song was written by Alex Kinchen and produced by Dash Brothers—Daniel Lindholm and Jesper Langberg—at KM Studios.

The Dash Brothers are internationally recognized music producers, known for their contributions to major video game franchises such as Capcom’s Street Fighter series (including Street Fighter V) and Resident Evil (Resident Evil 6), as well as titles like Lollipop Chainsaw. Daniel Lindholm, affiliated with Dagmusic, notably composed music for Resident Evil 6 and character themes for Street Fighter V Season 2, bridging two iconic Capcom universes.

Production was handled by Vincenzo Adelini, an Italian guitarist, composer, and producer celebrated for his work across classical, contemporary, and cinematic music. Adelini brings his expertise in both instrumental composition and modern electronic production, giving Black a unique balance of emotional depth and sonic sophistication. His international experience — performing and producing for diverse projects, including film scores and collaborative releases — adds a distinctive, expressive layer to the track.

Together, Alex and Vincenzo Adelini create Black as a bold follow-up to Alex’s debut, highlighting his evolving artistry and commitment to blending musical genres with compelling storytelling.

snippet.description:
“Boost” is a single by South Korean electronic artist ALEX 봉황 (Alex Kinchen), released as part of his FIRE And HEART B‑Side project. The song blends synth‑pop energy with sleek deep‑house rhythms, capturing a feeling of uplift and momentum that mirrors its title.

The lyrics for Boost were co‑written by Annie Ko, the lead vocalist and creative force behind the Seoul‑based electro duo Love X Stereo, known for their genre‑bending electronic and synth‑rock sound that’s gained recognition in the indie and international music scene.

Production was handled by IKEK (real name Shin Dong‑ik), working out of EQUAL Studio, where he brings precision and dynamic flair to the track’s arrangement and mix. Shin Dong‑ik’s work with EQUAL Studio includes mastering and production contributions for a range of Korean pop and indie releases, including credits tied to collaborations with artists and projects associated with groups like IZONE*, Blue D., and CSR, showcasing his versatility in contemporary music production.

Together, Alex, Annie Ko, and IKEK craft Boost as a memorable blend of emotional pop songwriting and forward‑driving electronic production, marking a standout moment in Alex’s evolving catalog.

snippet.description:
“Gravity” is the fifth standalone single from South Korean electronic artist ALEX 봉황 (Alex Kinchen), following earlier releases like “I Dare You,” “Boost,” “Black,” and “Better.” 

With Gravity, Alex reaches deeper into atmospheric textures and emotive energy, creating a sound that’s both expansive and introspective.

Production on the track was led by Nam Dong Hyun (남동현), a South Korean singer‑songwriter, producer, and musician known for his independent work under his own name after previously performing as BOYHOOD. Nam Dong Hyun first debuted as a solo artist in 2017 and has since become recognized for writing, composing, and producing his own music, blending introspective songwriting with modern indie‑pop and electronic influences. He was also a bassist in the band South Club and participated in Produce X 101, showcasing his versatility and deep connection to the creative process.

By collaborating with Nam Dong Hyun, Gravity brings together Alex’s immersive electronic and R&B vision and Nam’s rich indie‑producer sensibility.

snippet.description:
“I Dare You” is a song recorded by South Korean independent electronic artist Alex Kinchen, professionally known as ALEX 봉황. The track was released both as the opening song on the digital mini album iBBB and as his fourth standalone Korean single, following previous digital releases including “Boost,” “Black,” and “Better,” all issued through MYTHS And LEGENDS Records.

The visual art direction for “I Dare You” was created by Lee Min-Jeong, who has produced visual works for numerous artists under MUSIC&NEW. The song was written by Alex Kinchen and produced by Dash Brothers—Daniel Lindholm and Jesper Langberg—at KM Studios.

The Dash Brothers are internationally recognized music producers, known for their contributions to major video game franchises such as Capcom’s Street Fighter series (including Street Fighter V) and Resident Evil (Resident Evil 6), as well as titles like Lollipop Chainsaw. Daniel Lindholm, affiliated with Dagmusic, notably composed music for Resident Evil 6 and character themes for Street Fighter V Season 2, bridging two iconic Capcom universes.

“Black” is the second standalone single from South Korean electronic artist ALEX 봉황 (Alex Kinchen), following his debut release Boost. The track blends deep electronic textures with emotive melodies, creating a cinematic and immersive listening experience that builds on Alex’s signature sound.

Production was handled by Vincenzo Adelini, an Italian guitarist, composer, and producer celebrated for his work across classical, contemporary, and cinematic music. Adelini brings his expertise in both instrumental composition and modern electronic production, giving Black a unique balance of emotional depth and sonic sophistication. His international experience — performing and producing for diverse projects, including film scores and collaborative releases — adds a distinctive, expressive layer to the track.

Together, Alex and Vincenzo Adelini create Black as a bold follow-up to Alex’s debut, highlighting his evolving artistry and commitment to blending musical genres with compelling storytelling.

snippet.description:
“Boost” is a single by South Korean electronic artist ALEX 봉황 (Alex Kinchen), released as part of his FIRE And HEART B‑Side project. The song blends synth‑pop energy with sleek deep‑house rhythms, capturing a feeling of uplift and momentum that mirrors its title.

The lyrics for Boost were co‑written by Annie Ko, the lead vocalist and creative force behind the Seoul‑based electro duo Love X Stereo, known for their genre‑bending electronic and synth‑rock sound that’s gained recognition in the indie and international music scene.

Production was handled by IKEK (real name Shin Dong‑ik), working out of EQUAL Studio, where he brings precision and dynamic flair to the track’s arrangement and mix. Shin Dong‑ik’s work with EQUAL Studio includes mastering and production contributions for a range of Korean pop and indie releases, including credits tied to collaborations with artists and projects associated with groups like IZONE*, Blue D., and CSR, showcasing his versatility in contemporary music production.

Together, Alex, Annie Ko, and IKEK craft Boost as a memorable blend of emotional pop songwriting and forward‑driving electronic production, marking a standout moment in Alex’s evolving catalog.
